title: KLE Tech Fest 2025
description: Annual technology festival hosted by KLE Technological University featuring robotics competitions hackathons and project exhibitions. Industry leaders and over 5000 students gather for three days of innovation and networking. Live demonstrations of AI and embedded systems prototypes from across Karnataka.

title: Belagavi Food & Culture Festival
description: A three-day open-air festival celebrating the diverse culinary and artistic heritage of North Karnataka. Local chefs showcase traditional Dharwad pedha and Belagavi kunda alongside folk music and Dollu Kunitha dance performances. Free entry for children below 12.

title: Inter-College 24-Hour Hackathon
description: A 24-hour coding marathon open to all undergraduate engineering students across the Belagavi district. Teams of 3-4 solve real-world civic tech problems with mentors from Infosys and local startups. Cash prizes and internship opportunities for top three teams.

title: Belagavi Classical Music Evening
description: An intimate classical music concert featuring Hindustani vocal and sitar performances by faculty and alumni of the Gandharva Mahavidyalaya. Ragas for the evening season presented in the traditional concert format.

title: AI & Machine Learning Workshop
description: A hands-on two-day workshop covering supervised learning neural networks and model deployment using Python scikit-learn and TensorFlow. Participants build and deploy a mini-project by end of day two. Laptops mandatory.
venue: Gogte Institute of Technology Lab Block

title: Belagavi Half Marathon
description: Annual half marathon covering 21 km through the scenic cantonment and fort areas of Belagavi. Categories for open men open women and veterans. Medals for finishers and cash prizes for podium positions.

title: Open Source Contribution Day
description: A community meetup for developers to contribute to open source projects build portfolio projects and learn Git collaboration workflows. Beginners welcome with dedicated onboarding sessions.

title: Startup Pitch Night Belagavi
description: Eight early-stage Belagavi startups pitch to a panel of angel investors and VCs in a Shark Tank style format. Audience includes aspiring entrepreneurs MBA students and industry professionals. Networking dinner follows the event.

title: Inter-College Cricket Tournament
description: Three-day cricket tournament featuring 16 college teams from across North Karnataka. T20 format matches played on the university ground. Trophy and prize money for winners and runners-up.

title: Photography Walk & Exhibition
description: Guided photography walk through the historic Belagavi Fort and cantonment area followed by a pop-up exhibition of participant photos at Maratha Light Infantry Museum. Camera or smartphone participation welcome.

title: Data Science Career Fair
description: Industry recruiters from Infosys Wipro Persistent Systems and 12 other tech companies meet final-year students and recent graduates. Resume review sessions and on-the-spot HR interviews. Formal attire recommended.

title: Yoga & Wellness Camp
description: A three-day residential wellness retreat covering Hatha yoga pranayama and meditation for stress management. Certified yoga instructor leads morning and evening sessions. Vegetarian meals included in fees.

title: Electronics & IoT Expo
description: Exhibition showcasing student and industry projects in IoT embedded systems and consumer electronics. Prototype demonstrations hands-on demos of Raspberry Pi and Arduino projects. Component vendors on site.

title: Belagavi Rock & Indie Music Festival
description: Two-day outdoor music festival featuring 10 local and regional indie rock fusion and electronic bands. Food stalls and merchandise by local artists. All-ages event with a dedicated kids' zone.

title: Community Tree Plantation Drive
description: Volunteers plant 500 saplings at the outskirts of Belagavi in partnership with the Karnataka Forest Department. All tools and saplings provided. Certificates of participation issued to volunteers.

title: Web Development Bootcamp
description: Intensive 3-day bootcamp covering HTML CSS React and Node.js. Participants build a full-stack portfolio project by day three. Scholarship seats available for students from rural colleges.

title: Belagavi Craft Beer & Food Walk
description: A guided evening walk visiting four local restaurants and craft beverage pop-ups in the cantonment area. Curated food pairings and interaction with Belagavi's emerging food entrepreneurs. 21+ event.

title: Legal Aid & Awareness Camp
description: Free legal consultation camp offering guidance on consumer rights property disputes and labour law. Organised by the Belagavi Bar Association in partnership with Karnataka Legal Services Authority.

title: Robotics Competition for Schools
description: Inter-school robotics challenge for students in classes 8 through 12. Line follower sumo-bot and obstacle avoidance categories. Winning teams advance to the state-level competition.

title: Belagavi Book Fair
description: Annual district book fair featuring 60 publishers stalls covering literature science technology and comics. Author talks panel discussions and a dedicated children's reading corner. Free entry.

title: Competitive Coding Contest
description: Online-cum-offline competitive programming contest on Codeforces-style platform. Problems in algorithms dynamic programming and graph theory. Prizes for top 20 participants. Open to all skill levels.

title: Women in Tech Panel Discussion
description: Panel of six women leaders from engineering product management and data science discuss career growth challenges and opportunities for women in technology. Mentorship matchmaking session follows.

title: Belagavi Heritage Walk
description: Expert-guided walking tour of Belagavi Fort Safa Mosque and Kamala Basti temple complex with commentary on the layered history of Maratha Tipu Sultan and British-era Belagavi.

title: Cyber Security Awareness Workshop
description: Practical workshop covering phishing social engineering password hygiene and safe browsing. Targeted at college students and small business owners. CTF (Capture-the-Flag) challenge included.

title: North Karnataka Kabaddi Championship
description: District-level kabaddi tournament with 24 men's and women's teams from rural and urban North Karnataka. Traditional contact sport with enthusiastic local following.

title: Digital Marketing Masterclass
description: Full-day masterclass on SEO social media marketing Google Ads and content strategy for small businesses. Presented by certified digital marketing practitioners with live campaign demos.

title: Belagavi Kite Festival
description: Community kite-flying festival celebrating Sankranti traditions early. Participants of all ages. Stalls selling handmade kites. Colour and music filling the sky above the river floodplain.

title: Python for Data Analysis Workshop
description: One-day beginner-friendly workshop on pandas NumPy matplotlib and Seaborn for data wrangling and visualization. Datasets from real Belagavi civic data used. Bring your laptop.

title: Tabla & Percussion Festival
description: One-day intensive showcase of tabla khanjira and mridangam by masters from the Dharwad gharana and Carnatic tradition. Lecture demonstrations followed by jugalbandi concert.

title: Belagavi Street Art Project
description: Weekend community mural-painting event transforming a 200-metre wall in the Khade Bazar area. Artists and volunteers welcome. Materials provided. Family-friendly creative initiative.

title: Engineering Design Challenge
description: Interdisciplinary team challenge where students design cost-effective solutions for rural water access in North Karnataka. Judged on innovation feasibility and social impact. Prototype required.

title: Theatre Arts Festival
description: Three-day festival of one-act plays in Kannada Hindi and English staged by amateur theatre groups from across the Belagavi division. Awards for best direction best actor and best production design.

title: Blood Donation Camp
description: Voluntary blood donation camp organised in association with the KLE Hospital blood bank. All blood groups needed. Free health checkup for donors. Refreshments provided by volunteers.

title: Smart City Hackathon
description: 36-hour smart city hackathon challenging participants to build digital solutions for traffic waste management public safety and utilities in Tier-2 Indian cities. Sponsored by Belagavi Smart City Limited.

title: Belagavi Flower Show
description: Annual flower and garden show at the municipal botanical garden featuring over 200 varieties of flowers ornamental plants and bonsai. Gardening workshops and plant sale stalls.

title: Night Cycling Challenge
description: Midnight-to-dawn 50-km cycling event through the Belagavi-Khanapur highway under the full moon. Timing chips provided. All bicycles welcome. Safety vests and lights mandatory.

title: Rural Entrepreneurship Summit
description: Day-long summit connecting rural innovators with microfinance institutions NGOs and government schemes. Focus on agri-tech handicrafts and rural logistics. Presentations in Kannada and English.

title: Badminton Open Championship
description: Open district badminton championship in men's women's and mixed doubles. Categories for sub-junior junior and senior players. Affiliated to Badminton Association of India.

title: Blockchain & Web3 Seminar
description: Evening seminar exploring blockchain technology smart contracts DeFi and NFT applications with case studies from Indian fintech startups. Q&A session with crypto industry practitioners.

title: Rotary Club Blood & Health Drive
description: Combined health camp with free haemoglobin sugar and BP screening plus blood donation drive. Camp includes awareness sessions on diabetes and hypertension prevention.

title: Carnatic Vocal Concert
description: Solo Carnatic vocal recital by award-winning artist Vidushi Rashmi Somashekhar with violin and mridangam accompaniment. Evening ragas in traditional concert format with raga explanations for the uninitiated.

title: App Development Sprint
description: Weekend mobile app development sprint for iOS and Android using Flutter and React Native. Industry mentors from local tech companies guide teams through ideation design and prototype submission.
venue: Govt First Grade College IT Lab

title: Traditional Crafts Market
description: Artisan market showcasing handloom Kasuti embroidery Channapatna toys bell-metal work and other Karnataka craft traditions. Direct sales from artisans with no middlemen.

title: Environmental Awareness March
description: Student-led awareness march on World Environment Day themes covering plastic pollution river conservation and urban greening. March ends with a public pledge and display of eco-art.

title: Cloud Computing & DevOps Workshop
description: Two-day hands-on workshop on AWS basics Docker Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines. Participants deploy a containerized app to the cloud by end of day two. AWS Educate credits provided.

title: Inter-School Science Quiz
description: District-level science and general knowledge quiz for school students in classes 9 through 12. Questions on physics chemistry biology space science and current affairs in STEM.

title: Folk Dance & Music Night
description: Spectacular evening of Dollu Kunitha Veeragase Kolata and Yakshagana performances by troupes from across North Karnataka. Colourful costumes and traditional percussion instruments.

title: Fintech Innovation Challenge
description: Teams compete to build financial technology solutions addressing credit access digital payments and insurance for rural Karnataka. Partnered with RBI Innovation Hub and NPCI.

title: Astronomy Night & Star Gazing
description: Guided stargazing session away from city lights at the Belagavi reservoir outskirts. Telescopes provided. Talks on planets constellations and India's space programme by ISRO enthusiasts.

title: District Volleyball Tournament
description: Annual district volleyball tournament with teams from colleges government departments and corporate organizations. Men's and women's categories. Knockout format over two days.
